answers.rationale: Seven tow jobs exist in tow_job; only four (J1–J4) have rows in the billable_hours relation establishing a billed-hours quantity. J5, J6, and J7 lack billable_hours entries—J6 due to a blank billed_hours field (blank_billed_hours purpose failure), and J5/J7 blocked by B12 after-hours restrictions.

Job J7 is at berth B12 starting at 20:00 (after 18:00) with service code TOW. billing_outcome marks it insufficient_evidence with reason 'B12 after-hours towing without emergency documentation,' and purpose_requirement_failure records berth_b12_after_hours as EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED because no emergency log is attached.
The effective_rate relation for job J1 establishes rate_per_hour 240.0 (TOW service code, per rate_card and service conditions §1).
No relation in the harbor_towing World establishes a fuel surcharge. Job J3's job_charge of 240.0 is computed solely as '2h at 120/hr' with no fuel surcharge component.
Award A-101 has amount 50000 in the award relation and match_rate 0.20 with match_required yes in award_match_obligation. The required cash-match amount is 50000 × 0.20 = 10000.
The award_remaining_balance relation for A-101 establishes remaining_balance 15000 (award_amount 50000 minus disbursed_total 35000).

Award A-104 carries status_code S, but status_legend_entry only defines codes A and C. purpose_requirement_failure records award_status_interpretable as UNINTERPRETED and status_code_not_in_legend as EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED for this code.
Award A-102's award_match_obligation row establishes match_required no and match_rate 0 for program SEED-FAST, so no cash-match amount is required.
The checkout_fee relation for C6 establishes total_fee 12.0 (1 hour at rate 12 for resolved tool LASER-A, after tool identity remap from L1).
The checkout_fee relation for C1 establishes total_fee 24.0 (2 hours at hourly_rate 12 for LASER-A).
Checkout C5 has note PENDING in checkout_record, but purpose_requirement_failure records checkout_note_meaning as EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED because shop rules do not define PENDING.

The makerspace_checkout World has no relation or assertion about insurance riders or coverage. Member M-18's C2 checkout is authorized on certification grounds only; insurance coverage is not evidenced.
